fields.statement: Re-ran at 583b957 in a fresh detached worktree with RHIZA_* unset; all pass. review-check-worktree.txtar asserts each clause: (1) detached worktree at branch head: fake claude logs dir=checkout head=branch-head detached=yes root=run for alpha-1, beta-1, beta-2 (cmp want.log) and each pwd is under .git/rhiza/checkouts/<run>/<check>-check-<cycle>; (2) gone after session whatever its outcome: alpha-1 and beta-2 pass, beta-1 exits 1, and none of the three pwds exist afterwards nor appear in git worktree list; (3) finding and Evidence in the run worktree: alpha's findings entry (check alpha, cycle 1) is in the run journal and Evidence alpha-ok is a .json under the run worktree's .rhiza/log, while the checkout's git status stayed clean; (4) staged, unstaged and untracked edits made by a prior command step in the run worktree compare byte-equal before/after (git diff, diff --cached, status). Engine tests TestChecksStepCheckouts, TestChecksStepCheckoutResume, TestChecksStepCheckoutErrors, TestChecksStepNoFindingsRound pass (open/remove on pass and fail, resume, start/remove failures, D10 no-findings-round). Full go test ./... passes (21 packages ok).
